pretreatments.description: Thermophilic Pretreatment (TPP): Mixing of FW and inoculum in BMP bottles, incubated at varying temperatures (50, 60, 70, 80 °C) for varying times (12, 24, 36, 48 h), followed by reduction of incubator temperature to mesophilic conditions (35 ± 2 °C)
Conventional Thermal Pretreatment (CTP): Heating only FW to 50-80 °C for a selected duration, inoculum added subsequently in bottles, incubation at mesophilic conditions
